researchContext.summary: Attached 4 research insight(s) relevant to the current failure pattern in QQQ 120m.
matchedProblemTags: how to design regime-specific loser exits for low-trend/range-squeeze conditions that reduce adverse excursion without overcutting acceptable trades on 120m equity index systems.
methods for blocking or tapering counter-trend long exposure during trend_down regimes while preserving enough trade count to pass tradability constraints.
practical approaches for adding time-in-trade, momentum-fade, or staged partial exits that improve drawdown control more than they reduce expectancy.

insights.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
insights.summary: Prefer tapered counter-trend suppression in trend_down over full long-entry bans.
insights.suggestedMutation: In Pine, if regime == trend_down, require setupScore >= highTierThreshold for entry, or require close > fastEMA and ROC(len) > 0 before allowing longs; optionally reduce qty by 50% instead of blocking all entries.

insights.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
insights.summary: Use regime-specific loser exits only in low-trend states rather than tightening exits globally.
insights.suggestedMutation: In Pine, when regime == range or range_squeeze, replace the base stop with min(baseStop, entryPrice - k1*ATR) and add a close-condition exit if barsSinceEntry >= n1 and maxRunupATR < r1. Leave trend_up exits unchanged.

insights.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
insights.summary: Apply protective logic by setup tier so weaker setups get tighter exits and stronger setups retain baseline freedom.
insights.suggestedMutation: Define setup tiers from existing features (trend alignment, momentum, pullback depth, breadth/vol filter). For low-tier entries, enable tighter ATR stop and shorter time-stop in range_squeeze or trend_down; for high-tier entries, keep original stop and disable early momentum-fade unless loss exceeds y*ATR.

insights.title: Regime-aware exit tightening and trade-count recovery for 120m QQQ strategy
insights.summary: Add momentum-fade and time-in-trade exits as secondary exits for non-progressing positions.
insights.suggestedMutation: Track barsInTrade, highestSinceEntry, and runupATR = (highestSinceEntry - entryPrice)/ATR. If barsInTrade >= n2 and runupATR < r2, exit. Separately, if regime in [range, range_squeeze, trend_down] and RSI falls below x after entry or close crosses below fastEMA after failing to exceed r3*ATR runup, exit or trim 50%.
